title: TripActions x Visa Partnership Campaign
summary: An 18-month co-marketing campaign connecting the TripActions corporate card with a broader travel story.
overview: I directed creative for the TripActions and Visa co-marketing campaign, including custom photography featuring the physical expense card. The resulting owned imagery carried across web, campaigns, internal communications, print, and display formats.

projectBrief.context: Visa was the card issuer for TripActions Liquid, creating a partnership story across corporate travel, cards, and expense management.
projectBrief.challenge: The campaign needed to bring two established brands together while making the physical card and its role in the travel experience feel tangible.
projectBrief.contribution: I directed the 18-month co-marketing campaign and the custom photography featuring the Visa co-branded expense card.
projectBrief.approach: I worked with photographers, visual talent, partners, and internal teams to build an owned image library and adapt it across channels and approval requirements.
projectBrief.outcome: The photography replaced stock imagery and was reused across web, marketing, internal communications, print, and display campaigns.
